description: A copy of ALM's Stereo Sum: four stereo inputs summed into two stereo outputs, with the first pair feeding the second unless you use it

inputs.text: One of the two left signals added into the first pair of outputs
One of the two right signals added into the first pair of outputs
One of the two left signals added into the second pair of outputs
One of the two right signals added into the second pair of outputs

outputs.text: The first pair's two left signals added together; leaving this jack empty passes that sum on to the second pair's left output as well
The first pair's two right signals added together; leaving this jack empty passes that sum on to the second pair's right output as well
The second pair's two left signals added together, plus the first pair's left sum whenever the first left output is empty
The second pair's two right signals added together, plus the first pair's right sum whenever the first right output is empty

notes: with the upper outputs empty the module is one four-into-one stereo mixer. Patch them and it becomes two separate two-into-one mixers.
the left and right sides break apart on their own. Patching only the upper left output takes the left side out of the cascade and leaves the right side joined.
the module has no controls at all and nothing is clamped anywhere: it adds the voltages as they arrive.
the module is monophonic: every jack reads or writes one channel.
